title: Hearty Charred Syrian Ovoli Mushroom Stew
description: A dense and festive Syrian dish featuring charred ovoli mushrooms, perfect for a cold winter night, this slow-cooked stew is high in protein and flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the ovoli mushrooms and cook until they are charred and tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the ground cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and diced tomatoes, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the stew has thickened slightly.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
